scope: Windows native MainWindow with ordinary default model and isolated SettingsStore; Computer Use sky API; final frozen GUI source
observations: First page shows Flight and Ground hardware summary cards before shared wireless and device/resource summaries.

After the automatic toolchain task finished, all three tools were found, detect button was enabled and cancel-task control was absent. Both target generate buttons remained disabled and both labels retained Configuration incomplete / cannot generate.
Opened Ground hardware options, used its actual board dropdown to select SSGS0.5, and observed STM32F103C8T6 in the draft while the main Ground summary remained unconfigured.
Escape cancelled the draft. Alt+F4 closed the main window normally; no Python/SCG windows remained in the immediate returned window list.
The QApplication.aboutToQuit callback produced final-model.json. Its bytes equal initial-model.json exactly, demonstrating that navigation and cancelled edits did not change the project.
The launcher process was no longer running after normal close. No process termination was required.
Computer Use JavaScript kernel was immediately reset after the final window check, following the user's instruction to exit when mouse use is finished.
limitations: This manual run covers initial admission, overview, Ground draft cancellation and normal exit. Apply, Flight draft, stale asynchronous imports, migration and control-preview boundaries have separate automated evidence; this is not a claim of all desktop configurations or hardware generation validation.
